name: speech-to-text-transcription
title: Speech to Text Transcription - Whisper, Audio to Text
description: Most transcription actors charge for an error page or an hour of silence and hand back empty text. Here every file gets a row that says what happened, and only a delivered transcript is charged.

meta.memoryJustification: Whisper small needs 4096 MB on purpose: the SDK derives the worker thread count from memory (memory//4096 gives one thread), and the deadline plan in src/speech.py is measured on one thread. At a smaller memory the same file competes for CPU and a 10 minute recording overruns the run window instead of finishing inside it.
